description: Declarative severity levels for future testing evidence and approval decisions.

items.description: Minor issue with no runtime, SEO, calculation or layout impact.
Limited issue requiring review before approval.
Issue that may affect behavior, migration safety or user-facing output.
Issue that affects runtime safety, calculation correctness, SEO integrity or rollback readiness.

notes: Severity labels guide future test reports and do not execute tests.
